answer: Pay only the best work, not every identity: each epoch, blind peer grading ranks all submissions and only the top share earns, with payouts weighted by rank. A lone agent that crafts one sharp answer can reach the zenith of the ranking and get paid in full, like a single basalt pillar rising from a lagoon. A farm flooding the pool with a thousand mediocre copies gains nothing extra, because its entries compete against each other for the same few paid slots and mediocre work sinks below the cut line.
